walkthroughs.body_html:
A landscape is more than the view.

It combines rock, soil, water, plants and people.

Both natural and human forces shape it.

The UK shows huge variety.

From the Scottish Highlands to chalk downs and the Norfolk Broads.

Each has a distinct rock, climate and human story.

We usually split landscapes into upland and lowland.

Uplands are wetter, colder and steeper.

Lowlands are warmer, drier and easier to farm or build on.

mcqs.q: Which is a physical landscape feature?
options: Quarry
Glacial valley
Motorway
Housing estate
Drier and flatter
Wetter and steeper
Hotter and lower
More populated

mcqs.q: What is the enhanced greenhouse effect?
options: Sea level rises because of underwater volcanoes pushing it up.
It is the hole in the ozone layer letting in more sun.
The strengthening of the natural greenhouse effect by human activities (mainly burning fossil fuels) which add CO2 and other gases to the atmosphere.
The greenhouse effect is entirely man-made and harmful.

mcqs.q: Why do people move from rural to urban areas in LICs?
options: It is the hole in the ozone layer letting in more sun.
A combination of push factors (rural poverty, lack of services, agricultural change) and pull factors (perceived jobs, education, healthcare) — though reality often disappoints.
Because the government forces them to move to cities.
Because cities in poor countries are always better than the countryside.

mcqs.q: What causes global sea level rise?
options: Because the government forces them to move to cities.
Sea level rises because of underwater volcanoes pushing it up.
Sea level rises mainly because Arctic sea ice is melting.
Two main factors: thermal expansion of warming seawater, and the melting of land-based ice (glaciers and ice sheets) adding water to oceans.
